ROUTE: Plover-235B
REASON: My choice stands. The query is a general knowledge explanation with an instruction-following component (be concise, no padding). Plover leads on the benchmarks most predictive of that—general knowledge (MMLU-Pro 81.2 vs 74.8) and instruction following (IFEval 89.8 vs 85.6)—while cost, latency, and context window are identical across the fleet. There's no content sensitivity or task preference that would favor Whimbrel, so I route to the stronger model.
